digest.component_or_area: completion verifier / structured LLM output extraction
propositions: The completion verifier returns a DEPENDENCY-LINK record (with keys relation, target_id, link_uuid) instead of a CompletionVerdict when the model quotes a dep record in prose before emitting the verdict.

The root cause is schema-blind selection in tolerant_parse and _first_json_object: both return the first JSON object that *parses* rather than the first that satisfies the target schema (CompletionVerdict).

The selection policy is deliberate and pinned (first-wins to prevent last-wins surprises on draft-then-correction replies), and is shared across all structured LLM gates (plan-review, ticket-digest, overlap, epic-bug-screen), making any fix a verification behavior change.

A permanent fix requires three atomic layers: provider-native output where proven (Layer 1), prompted-path hardening with sentinel channel and schema-filtered last-valid-wins (Layer 2), and invariant tests capturing the general contract rather than instance layouts (Layer 3).
